text:
tara: Heads-up 1 I opened a small PR that consolidates a few scattered Optimize tips: batching heuristics, kv-cache behavior note, and a short TypeScript snippet showing per-route prefetch + graceful fallback. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4722 :sparkles:
kevin: Thanks 1 Can you paste the TS snippet inline so I can check async/error handling?
mohit: Also, we should avoid the phrase 'zero accuracy loss' in quant notes. Use 'minimal observed quality delta' and link to the evals page.
tara: Pasted snippet in the PR. Main pattern: use PrefetchClient, call prefetch and handle errors with .catch, and always call client.shutdown() in finally. Example shows batch=6 and seqLen=1024.
kevin: Quick nit: the SDK renamed `OldPrefetcher` -> `PrefetchClient` in v0.9; good to add a 1-line migration table mapping old->new.
tara: Added migration table: `OldPrefetcher -> PrefetchClient` and `setup() -> init()`.
devdocs-bot: checklist: [x] PR opened, [ ] reviewer assigned, [ ] snippets linted, [ ] links validated, [ ] UX wording reviewed
link-bot: link-check: found 1 internal anchor mismatch: `/docs/optimize/prefetch` -> canonical is `/docs/optimize/prefetching#per-route`
tara: Thanks link-bot. Updated link to /docs/optimize/prefetching#per-route and fixed a broken internal reference to the qprofile page too.
ci-bot: CI: md-lint passed, snippets/format-check failed (ts)
tara: Running prettier locally, pushing a small formatting fix.
(90s later)
tara: Fixed formatting and removed a stray `console.log`. Pushed.
ci-bot: CI: snippets/format-check passed, link-bot: 1 external redirect detected (partner doc)
kevin: Which external link?
tara: The partner integration doc was 302 -> updated to canonical partner URL. Pushed.
devdocs-bot: checklist: [x] PR opened, [x] reviewer assigned (kevin), [x] snippets linted, [x] links validated, [ ] UX wording reviewed
mohit: For the quant profile section please include the mapping from legacy profile names to new canonical IDs (eg `qprof-legacy-small` -> `qprof-stable-small-int8`) and a short reproduce note: batch, seq len, hw.
tara: Added mapping and a concise reproduce bullet: - hw: T4 - batch: 6 - seq_len: 1024 - quant_profile: qprof-stable-small-int8 - observed: ~11ms/token (with ~80% prefix hit). Kept language "minimal observed quality delta" and linked /docs/optimize/evals/regression-alerts.
kevin: Code LGTM. One suggestion: show the one-liner for installing a pinned SDK version to reduce confusion: `npm i @redwood/inference@0.9.3`
tara: Added the install line at the top of the snippet.
ci-bot: All checks green on latest commit, preview deployed: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/optimize/ts-prefetch-consolidation
kevin: Quick smoke: preview looks fine, snippets highlight correctly, anchors resolve.
mohit: Verified qprofile mapping and evals link. lgtm.
tara: Merged and deployed to prod. Thanks team 1 This should cut down the recurring support threads about when to use prefetch vs kv-cache and avoid a few migration gotchas. :tada:
